verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL is documented to run directly on the data lake with ANSI SQL plus Delta Lake extensions, building warehouses "without moving your data" (databricks-docs-32). Delta tables also support time-travel queries (databricks-docs-54) and streaming reads (databricks-docs-68), so in-place querying of the Delta open format is covered. Iceberg and raw Parquet file querying are never mentioned, and the cloud-storage file evidence (databricks-docs-13) describes ingestion rather than querying in place. missing for 10: documented Iceberg table querying, direct Parquet/file querying in object storage, independent hands-on corroboration of in-place open-format querying.
